feeds.title: Dennis Sisterson Animation Blog
feeds.description: I've been working as an independent animator, mostly in London, since 1998. Although I always enjoy working on narrative cartoon-type material, I feel there is a great deal of untapped potential in animation as a tool for communication and education and I'm always looking for opportunities to explore this.

feeds.title: Fudge Animation Journal
feeds.description: The latest news section of the Fudge Animation website has been providing latest news about the animation industry, interviews, inspiration, as well as art and design influences from the world of animation. An award-winning independent animation studio based in the UK, it inspires and motivates target audiences with distinctive character animation.
